ABOUT US
We are Robb and Brenda Greene, current owners of Castle Creek Manor Bed and Breakfast. We fell in love with the Grand Junction area many years ago and vacationed here several times a year knowing one day we wanted to relocate here and waited for the perfect opportunity.
In 2019, while staying at the bed and breakfast and attending the Colorado Mountain Winefest, we discovered Castle Creek was listed for sale. We couldn't pass up this amazing opportunity to move to the place we loved and to fulfill Brenda's dream of owning her own business and running a bed and breakfast. We successfully purchased the business and started 2020 as the new owners.
Robb works from home and continues to work his career while also providing much needed support to Brenda who runs the daily operations of the business. In our free time, we enjoy kayaking on the Colorado River, fishing, golfing, skiing, mountain biking, hiking, wine tasting and exploring all that Grand Junction has to offer. Brenda is increasing her garden to incorporate more garden to table produce for guests to enjoy during their stay.
We love meeting new people and live our motto "Arrive as guests, leave as friends."
ABOUT CASTLE CREEK MANOR
Situated centrally in the Grand Valley in the heart of Grand Junction, Castle Creek Manor features a spa like design with an expansive two-story deck providing private outside entrances to each of the five luxury suites. Each of the king size bed suites offer relaxation, peace, and tranquility. While staying here you will enjoy the cozy atmosphere of the bed and breakfast.
Open year-round, Castle Creek Manor offers extraordinary comforts and impeccable service. Along with spacious suites, offering in each room a two-person jacuzzi tub, separate shower, fireplace, WiFi, cable and mini-refrigerator and microwave.
Our aim at Castle Creek Manor is to make our guests feel like family and not just customers. Guests will have an experience that far exceeds any hotel stay. Castle Creek Manor Bed and Breakfast provides a personal, warm and friendly welcome with peaceful surroundings and a delicious home cooked breakfast and serving locally roasted coffee.
Vacationers and business travelers experience a home away from home atmosphere when they stay at Castle Creek Manor. While in the area, visitors will find many things to do in town and around the area to include the Colorado National Monument, wineries, bicycling trails, lavender fields, hiking trails along with Powderhorn Ski Resort. The Grand Mesa is a short drive from our location and features over 300 lakes, perfect for boaters, anglers, hikers, kayakers, and swimmers. Rattlesnake Canyon offers the largest cluster of arches in Colorado. The trifecta of the Colorado National Monument, The Grand Mesa and the Rattlesnake Canyon offers a special guest experience only available in the Grand Valley. Truly a unique tourist destination like no other in the world.
Each of the five guest rooms are named after areas found in Grand Junction and each decorated to celebrate these great amenities. With five guest rooms, it's ideal for weddings, small reunions, birthdays and anniversaries or for any group wanting to get away and be in a more private and small location than a traditional hotel.
